relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: This work uses progressive planning and reinforced reasoning for LLM-guided multi-hop KGQA. Our idea enriches training triples with local context subgraphs from the same passage and adds an adaptive repair loop for one-hop failures, focusing on training data enrichment and iterative correction rather than planning and reinforcement reasoning mechanisms.
